description: This file defines classes and methods for fetching and processing price target consensus data from the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and asynchronous data retrieval.

classes.name: FMPPriceTargetConsensusQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for FMP price target consensus, including symbol validation.

classes.name: FMPPriceTargetConsensusData
classes.description: Represents the price target consensus data fetched from FMP.

classes.name: FMPPriceTargetConsensusFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, transforming, and processing price target consensus data asynchronously from FMP API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FMPPriceTargetConsensusQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves raw data from FMP API for given symbols, handling errors and warnings.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into validated FMPPriceTargetConsensusData instances.
